verdict.rationale: Factory's Agent Readiness docs describe a first-party `/readiness-report` slash command, available in the Factory App and the Droid CLI, that evaluates a repository's readiness level. A companion `/readiness-fix` command fixes failing criteria, which shows the report is criteria-based. missing for 10: documentation of the specific criteria and level definitions, details of the report output format, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run a readiness report that evaluates how ready my repository is for autonomous agents

citations.quote: Run the /readiness-report slash command in a Factory App web or desktop session, or in the Droid CLI, to evaluate a repository's readiness level
Automatically fix failing criteria with the /readiness-fix slash command in a Factory App web or desktop session, or in the Droid CLI
